name: process_terminate
title: Stop Process
description: Graceful SIGTERM first; force=true escalates to hard kill. High-risk on system PIDs: prefer managed handles.

process_id.description: Opaque process handle returned by process_start. 128-bit entropy, never parsed.

force.description: Escalate from graceful SIGTERM to hard kill.

grace_ms.description: Grace window before SIGKILL escalation (ignored when force=true).

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
